# WenHairCare Fig Cleansing Conditioner: Gentle Cleansing and Smooth, Strong Hair

Wen Fig gives you a cleanse and condition in one step. Its sulfate-free formula is designed to clean hair gently while leaving it soft, moisturized, and easier to manage. Use it on a wash day, and enjoy a simpler routine with noticeably smoother hair.

## Simplify Your Wash Day

Wen Fig combines cleansing and conditioning in a single product, so you can skip a separate conditioner. That means fewer steps in the shower and a streamlined routine you can keep up with every week.

## Smooth, Detangled Hair

Fine, easily tangled hair can make every wash a struggle. Many customers find that Wen Fig makes combing through wet and dry hair noticeably easier, helping reduce frustrating knots after shampooing.

## Soft, Moisturized Strands

Wen Fig's rich, hydrating formula helps dry hair feel softer and more supple. Customers often describe their hair as smooth and shiny after regular use.

## Gentle, Sulfate-Free Care

Free of harsh sulfates, this formula cleanses without stripping hair of its natural oils. It's a thoughtful choice for anyone who wants to keep their hair feeling balanced and healthy over time.

## Long-Lasting Value

At 16 oz, this 16-ounce bottle is a practical size for regular use. Many long-time fans have kept coming back to Wen for its consistent results.

**Ready for softer, easier-to-manage hair?** Add WenHairCare Fig to your cart today and experience the difference in your next wash.
